subject: NebulaCloud Dedicated Capacity: Turn-up & Autoscale Orchestration
messages:
From: Jordan Park <jordan.park@nebulacloud.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@nebulacloud.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity turn-up — timeline & regional preference

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NebulaCloud is ready to move forward with a Dedicated GPU pool for our inference workloads. Two quick asks to get the onboarding sprint scheduled:

1) We need confirmation on regional placement: primary in us-west1, failover in us-east1. Are both available for a single Dedicated tenant?
2) We expect a baseline of 12 concurrent seats at 4k token/s sustained with periodic bursts up to 36 seats during peak experiments. Can you confirm autoscale/burst policy options and guardrails?

We have Procurement on copy — I can share a PO once we lock scope. Would like to target a week-of-June-22 provisional turn-up if you have capacity.

Appreciate it,
Jordan

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity turn-up — timeline & regional preference

Jordan — thanks, excited to partner on this. Quick answers and a proposed next step: 

- Regional availability: we can provision a single Dedicated tenant with primary in us-west1 and a configured failover region in us-east1. We'll validate bisection bandwidth for KV cache fallbacks during the activation window.
- Autoscale/burst: we support a baseline reserved pool + burst lanes. For your profile I recommend: reserved baseline = 12 seats, soft autoscale to 24 seats with 12-seat burst buffer enabled for short windows (configurable cooldowns). We can extend to 36 seats for scheduled experiments but that requires a pre-warmed burst or short-term reserved increase.

Proposed next step: plan a 30-minute technical handshake this Friday (June 12) with Karthik to review the provisioning checklist and Grace to align CS activation tasks. Ben will cover contract/PO cadence and any billing implications.

If that works I'll send a calendar invite and attach our activation checklist + an editable MAP (mutual action plan).

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel

Jordan / Monica — quick note on commercials so Procurement has context:

- Baseline (12 seats) will be covered under the reserved capacity monthly commitment in the SOW.
- Autoscale soft-limits (to 24 seats) are included; bursts to 36 seats are treated as short-term overage or can be covered by a temporary uplift (7–14 day ramp) to avoid per-token overage charges.
- If you prefer predictable economics for the upcoming experiments, we can accept a short-term PO for a 2-week uplift at the committed rate; that simplifies billing and reduces risk of throttling.

I'll loop legal for SOW redlines once you send the PO. If Procurement needs a formal quote document I can push one today.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Park <jordan.park@nebulacloud.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity turn-up — timeline & regional preference

Jordan — thanks for the details. A few technical clarifications ahead of the Friday handshake: 

1) Model/sequence profile: please confirm your 95th pct sequence length and whether KV caching will be shared across requests or pinned per-session. That affects pre-warm sizing and GPU memory estimates.
2) Networking: for cross-region failover we recommend a transit VPC peering pattern with at least 2x10Gbps streams; we will perform an inter-region KV sync test during activation.
3) Autoscale policy: we'll propose the following defaults in the checklist:
   - target_concurrency_per_gpu = 2.5
   - soft_scale_threshold = 85% sustained utilization over 60s
   - burst_window_max = 15 minutes
   - cooldown = 10 minutes after a burst
I've attached the provisioning checklist with these fields pre-populated. If you can fill the model/tokens info before the handshake we can run a capacity simulation and confirm exact instance SKUs.

Proposed kickoff: Monday June 22 at 09:00 PT for a provisional turn-up (we'll run the pre-warm and KV sync during that window). If you need a different time we can adjust.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
